scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features sqlite-precompiled,canister-api && mkdir -p target/pocketic && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/ic_sqlite_vfs.wasm target/pocketic/ic_sqlite_vfs.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:failpoints: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features sqlite-precompiled,canister-api-test-failpoints && mkdir -p target/pocketic && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/ic_sqlite_vfs.wasm target/pocketic/ic_sqlite_vfs_failpoints.wasm
scripts.build:compat:0.2.2: cd compat-fixtures/ic-sqlite-vfs-0-2-2 && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cd ../.. && mkdir -p target/pocketic && cp compat-fixtures/ic-sqlite-vfs-0-2-2/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/ic_sqlite_vfs_compat_0_2_2.wasm target/pocketic/ic_sqlite_vfs_compat_0_2_2.wasm
scripts.build:bench:wasm: cd benchmarks/kv-canister && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cd ../.. && mkdir -p target/pocketic && cp benchmarks/kv-canister/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/ic_sqlite_vfs_kv_bench.wasm target/pocketic/ic_sqlite_vfs_kv_bench.wasm
scripts.build:bench:ic-rusqlite: cd benchmarks/ic-rusqlite-kv-canister && cargo build --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && wasi2ic target/wasm32-wasip1/release/ic_rusqlite_kv_bench.wasm target/wasm32-wasip1/release/ic_rusqlite_kv_bench_nowasi.wasm && cd ../.. && mkdir -p target/pocketic && cp benchmarks/ic-rusqlite-kv-canister/target/wasm32-wasip1/release/ic_rusqlite_kv_bench_nowasi.wasm target/pocketic/ic_rusqlite_kv_bench.wasm
scripts.test:pocketic:regression: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:failpoints && node --test tests/pocketic/upgrade.test.mjs
scripts.test:pocketic:compat: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:compat:0.2.2 && node --test tests/pocketic/cross_version.test.mjs
scripts.test:pocketic: npm run test:pocketic:regression && npm run test:pocketic:compat && npm run test:pocketic:perf
